rule_statement: Output file matching_results.tsv is required; candidate_pairs.tsv is required for final submission.
Files must be strictly Tab-Separated (.tsv) and valid UTF-8 text.
validation_logic: Check encoding utf-8 and presence of '\t' delimiter without raw comma delimitation.

rule_statement: Header rows must match exact expected column names: source1_entity_id\tmatched_entity_ids and source1_entity_id\tcandidate_entity_ids.
validation_logic: First line must equal exact tab-separated list.

rule_statement: Every Source 1 entity in test_source1.tsv must appear in submission outputs exactly once.
Duplicate source1_entity_id rows are strictly forbidden.
Matched and candidate IDs must only have S2- or S3- prefixes.
Self-matches (S1- IDs in matched or candidate lists) are strictly forbidden.
validation_logic: not any(id.startswith('S1-') for id in list)

rule_statement: Repeated entity IDs inside a single matched or candidate list are forbidden.
Singletons / empty predictions must be an empty string following tab, never 'nan', 'null', 'None'.
Final matches must be a subset of candidate blocking pairs for each Source 1 entity.
Matched entity IDs should exist in test_source2.tsv or test_source3.tsv.
Evaluation metric is Macro-averaged F_0.5 with explicit singleton credit (1.0 for true empty & pred empty, 0.0 for true empty & pred non-empty).
Model parameter count must not exceed 8 Billion parameters.
Pretrained models must be licensed under MIT or Apache 2.0.
Zero external business databases, entity resolution APIs, government registries, or geocoding APIs allowed.
validation_logic: Audit code for zero outbound network calls and zero external lookup artifacts
